requirements.observations: All ten views show one upright, open, smoothly tapered vessel whose twelve outward lobes begin subtly 48.33 mm below the top and increase with a smooth eased transition through the upper third. The lobes reach their full 4 mm extension at the rim without cut-in notches or a projecting flange. The planting cavity remains circular and unobstructed, the 288-segment loft gives consistent fine faceting, and the underside retains exactly five clean drainage openings. Opposing views agree without clipping, fragments, unintended holes, or merged features.

views.observations: Front elevation shows subtle modulation beginning at the upper-third boundary and growing smoothly into outward rim peaks, with no abrupt band and a stable flat base.
Rear elevation matches the front and confirms the scallops ease gradually into the body without cut-in notches.
Left elevation confirms the smooth upper-third fade, outward rim extension, full body height, and continuous wall.
Right elevation agrees with the left and contains no abrupt transition, missing, or detached scallop segments.
Top view clearly shows twelve smooth outward lobes around the full perimeter, a circular inner opening, and the unchanged five-hole drainage pattern.
Bottom view shows the circular flat base and exactly five clean through-openings; the gradual scallop growth does not disturb the lower body.
Front isometric resolves the twelve lobes emerging continuously through the upper third and angling outward toward the rim, with a circular cavity and smooth body taper.
Rear isometric confirms the eased twelve-lobe treatment wraps consistently around the complete perimeter and reaches full depth only at the rim.
Underside front isometric confirms the gradual upper-wall extensions are connected into the body and all five drainage holes pass through the floor.
Opposing underside view confirms the same continuous upper-third fade, clean base edge, and absence of detached geometry.
